│ interface to receive notifications from workers upon task completion.        │
│                                                                              │

│ interface. Each worker contains a Process method to perform specific tasks   │
│ and inform the Manager when done.                                            │
│                                                                              │
│ The Factory design pattern is implemented in the WorkerFactory class,        │
│ responsible for instantiating WorkerA, WorkerB, and WorkerC objects and      │
│ returning them as a collection of IWorker instances.                         │
│                                                                              │
│ Interaction within the architecture is facilitated by the Manager class.     │
│ When the Run method is called, the Manager generates workers using the       │
│ WorkerFactory, then iterates through each worker to execute their Process    │
│ method. Workers utilize the Notify method to communicate task completion to  │
│ the Manager.                                                                 │
│                                                                              │
│ This architecture emphasizes a clear division of responsibilities, with the  │
│ Manager overseeing workflow, Workers executing tasks, and the Factory        │
│ handling worker creation.                                                    │
